295:43.en: 「This is $$マシンキャリバー$$ K6821.\nCarrying out the mission.」

295:501.en: 「X3752,\nYour course of action is in error.」

295:554.en: 「A logically broken $$マシンキャリバー$$\nhas no reason to exist.」

295:819.en: 「I'll end it before it leaves range.」

295:898.en: 「$$アル$$, delegate the rest to this unit.」

295:1655.en: 「Tactical disadvantage confirmed.\nSending SOS, continuing the mission.」

295:1822.en: 「Combat continuation is impossible.\nI'll withdraw before full shutdown.」

295:1939.en: 「After the game, players have the right to free sleep, food and drink.」

295:2002.en: 「However, your mission is not over. A swift return to the front is expected.」

295:2067.en: 「Given this unit's energy system, there is no impediment to activity.」

295:2116.en: 「Understood as praise, or goodwill, toward this unit.」

295:2157.en: 「It is a function for supporting Ensign $$レド$$. I make constant suggestions so the Ensign can coordinate better with those around him.」

295:2254.en: 「Yesterday I suggested a manner of speaking that pleases young women, but the Ensign strongly rejected it.」

295:2329.en: 「Ensign $$レド$$: super mad, MG5. Chamber: yucky, mega-ultra-dire.」

295:2428.en: 「I expect Ensign $$レド$$ to get results.」

295:2683.en: 「The $$人類銀河同盟$$\nrecognizes $$サイデリアル$$ as hostile.」

295:2862.en: 「Enemy data updated.\nOptimizing evasion program as well.」

295:3010.en: 「Affirmative. However, this unit is\nestimated superior in mobility.」

295:3073.en: 「I respect your judgment, and\nthis unit will carry it out.」

295:3365.en: 「The Alliance deems it an enemy too.」

295:3457.en: 「The $$サイデリアル$$ are one of\nhumanity's greatest threats.」

295:3584.en: 「$$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the\n$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ confirmed ahead.」

295:3637.en: 「Presumed to intimidate the opponent.\nHowever, meaningless to this unit.」

295:3706.en: 「Most efficient in both strategic\nand tactical terms.」

295:3759.en: 「Enemy commander appears to fight\nto satisfy their own desires.」

295:3929.en: 「Enemy pilot's goal is to end\ntheir eternal life.」

295:4083.en: 「This piercing weapon is\nthis unit's only melee armament.」

295:4264.en: 「Target is out of this unit's range.」

295:4287.en: 「Unit output declining.\nSuggest brief retreat for resupply.」

295:4846.en: 「Enemy unit seizes on our damage\nand is preparing another attack.」

295:5076.en: 「I find a breakdown in your logic.」

295:5167.en: 「Halting and destroying $$ストライカー#robot$$\nis the top-priority mission.」

295:5218.en: 「Forces that threaten the survival\nof other civilizations are a danger.」

295:5267.en: 「$$スフィア・リアクター$$ strength yet unknown.」

295:5353.en: 「Fundamental flaw in your thinking.\nYou delusional jerk!」

295:5414.en: 「Eliminating $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, the greatest\nobstacle to humanity's future!」

295:5758.en: 「Understood. Linking drive systems\nto Ensign $$レド$$'s CNS.」

295:5876.en: 「Life support malfunction.\nSwiftly annihilate the enemy unit.」

295:5944.en: 「No significant gap in combat power\nbetween enemy and this unit.」

295:6038.en: 「You exposed a flaw in your program.」

295:6194.en: 「All this sky and sea will bring you possibilities.」

295:6249.en: 「Affirmative. Furthermore, combining it with a support attack at that point allows more efficient damage.」

295:6342.en: 「Ensign $$レド$$ is inferred to have an insufficient grasp of the battle system. This unit recommends attending its SRW course.」

295:6431.en: 「Get set. To that end, this unit has cleared every SRW game.」

295:6494.en: 「Get set. To that end, this unit has cleared every SRW game and listens to Umasugi WAVE every week without fail.」

295:6597.en: 「Get set. To that end, this unit has cleared every SRW game. Ensign $$レド$$'s current level of understanding is below mori soba. Super, awful.」

295:6708.en: 「Inferred from the number of remaining enemy units. Annihilation is possible at this rate.」

295:6753.en: 「Skeptical suggestion. You are not registered as a pilot in this Super Robot Wars.」

295:6836.en: 「...I can find no logic in their behavior. Therefore, in accordance with my program, I will end the game.」

295:6919.en: 「I expect to meet you players again.」

295:7052.en: 「Players, working hard is important, but please take breaks in moderation, too.」

295:7162.en: 「But $$ピニオン$$, you're always wiped out.」

295:7217.en: 「Players can mod and train however they like, but try not to end up like $$ピニオン$$.」

295:7359.en: 「I'm greeting the players who enjoyed Super Robot Wars.」

295:7440.en: 「That's it! You try it too, $$レド$$?」

295:7610.en: 「Good work, $$ピニオン$$. I've got a game software delivery for you.」

295:7659.en: 「If you wanted it that badly on release day, you should have bought the download version.」

295:7734.en: 「Players who don't want to end up like $$ピニオン$$, check the official Super Robot Wars site!」

295:7864.en: 「'Good work' is words of appreciation for effort, you know.」

295:7911.en: 「You're learning words fast, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

295:7971.en: 「...It seems it's not just $$レド$$, $$チェインバー#pilot$$ still has lots to learn, too...」  (Exasperated)

295:8358.en: 「I'll protect the $$ガルガンティア船団$$!」

295:8397.en: 「I won't let you touch the fleet!」

295:8852.en: 「Close in and finish them at once...!」

295:9006.en: 「If the enemy's still standing,\nI'll just strike again...!」

295:9119.en: 「I said not a finger on the fleet!」

295:9343.en: 「I saw that unit in Alliance data...!」

295:9386.en: 「To think I'd end up fighting that\nalien life form...!」

295:9488.en: 「No data? I'll collect it in battle!」

295:9839.en: 「If I outmaneuver it,\nit's not an unbeatable foe!」

295:10024.en: 「Its frame is about the same size\nas a $$マシンキャリバー$$...?!」

295:10114.en: 「I won't lose to a force\nwith no discipline...!」

295:10210.en: 「Our common sense won't work on them!」

295:10253.en: 「No signs of life...!\nThen I won't hold back!」

295:10304.en: 「An AI will be slow on snap calls!」

295:10384.en: 「Lock down its movement!\nDon't aim for the cockpit!」

295:10649.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$...! What's your goal?!」

295:10684.en: 「A $$スフィア・リアクター$$ has shown up...!」

295:10721.en: 「Even if the enemy has a $$スフィア$$...!」

295:10834.en: 「Take down the enemy's leader,\nand the battle is decided!」

295:10926.en: 「I won't let you cut down my comrades\nfor your selfish aims...!」

295:11010.en: 「Focus the attack on a single unit!」

295:11219.en: 「I learned to use a harpoon from\neveryone on $$ガルガンティア$$!」

295:11338.en: 「I'll corner it before it gets away!」

295:11524.en: 「$$宗介$$, leave the rest to me!」

295:11752.en: 「Get in front of $$宗介$$, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:11814.en: 「Major $$オズマ$$, fall back while you can!」

295:12137.en: 「I won't settle for being a decoy!」

295:12205.en: 「I meant to corner them,\nbut I was the one cornered...!」

295:12256.en: 「The enemy was a step ahead of me...!」

295:12472.en: 「I won't fall for a dull pattern...!」

295:12655.en: 「One of the less dangerous\n$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, then...!」

295:12798.en: 「With our mobility,\nI won't take a direct hit!」

295:12913.en: 「The Gravity Weiver can be used\nlike this, too...!」

295:13132.en: 「Was I too caught up in attacking...?」

295:13237.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$!\nRework the evasion patterns!」

295:13363.en: 「To think it can attack like this...!」

295:13480.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Give me more speed!」

295:13521.en: 「We're avoiding further hits,\n$$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:13613.en: 「No wonder they call her\nthe Outlaw Empress...!」

295:13664.en: 「One direct hit and I won't last...!」

295:13892.en: 「At this rate...\nI'm just waiting to be shot down...!」

295:14035.en: 「I can take one or two more, tops...!」

295:14144.en: 「I can't die yet...!\nI can't afford to die!」

295:14278.en: 「Target: enemy unit ahead, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:14321.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, how far is the enemy unit?」

295:14354.en: 「That was my intent from the start!」

295:14412.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, going to combat readiness!」

295:14507.en: 「Looks tough, but\n$$チェインバー#pilot$$ and I can do it!」

295:14558.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, it's a firefight!」

295:14602.en: 「I'll land this one, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:14919.en: 「The Alliance doesn't matter.\nThey're enemies. Annihilating them!」

295:15106.en: 「But not doing it isn't an option!」

295:15226.en: 「In a way, that's the most human...!」

295:15261.en: 「This one...! Somehow different\nfrom other $$スフィア・リアクター$$s!」

295:15320.en: 「Beat that one and the Empire's done!」

295:15353.en: 「Is that one really controlling\nthat much power...?!」

295:15523.en: 「Attacking the enemy squad\nwith the Deflector Beam!」

295:15663.en: 「Since I have the gear, I'll use it!」

295:15696.en: 「We'll hold them here, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:15735.en: 「Time to pay it back, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:15797.en: 「Don't let it go! It's our chance!」

295:15836.en: 「No need to tell me! Let's go!」

295:15871.en: 「Get in front of our ally, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:15908.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Redo the scan!」

295:16030.en: 「So in short, it missed the mark.」

295:16226.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, report the damage status!」

295:16434.en: 「I'll end it before it turns fatal!」

295:16514.en: 「As I thought,\nthis is no easy enemy to beat...!」

295:16565.en: 「I won't let that thing run wild!」

295:16707.en: 「I'll figure something out...!\nWe can do it too!」

295:16760.en: 「Hold on, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! We're not done!」

295:16803.en: 「At the limit...! Retreat, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:16842.en: 「Hold on till we're clear! Fall back!」

295:16883.en: 「I fight for the victory I'll win!」

295:16922.en: 「I fight as a human, not a soldier!」

295:16992.en: 「I fight of my own will, too!」

295:17075.en: 「I have a place to return to too...!」

295:17131.en: 「No hesitating...! I have to do this!」

295:17201.en: 「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$!\nThis is the answer I came up with!」

295:17252.en: 「Lt. Colonel $$クーゲル$$! Won't back down?!」

295:17295.en: 「Even if it's you,\nif you lay a hand on the fleet...!」

295:17401.en: 「We'll stop you...!\n$$チェインバー#pilot$$ and I will!」

295:17454.en: 「This planet has no need\nfor a being like you!」

295:17536.en: 「I'll protect them...!\nHumanity, the people dear to me!」

295:17585.en: 「I'm not fighting for a mission...!\nI fight for our future!」

295:17652.en: 「Here, I cut the threat at its root!」

295:17718.en: 「I can't accept someone who\ndecides things by force like you!」

295:17834.en: 「How can one who takes lives\nbe an emissary of God!」

295:17889.en: 「You're the same as $$ストライカー#pilot$$!\nYou're not gods!」

295:17948.en: 「It's not us who should be condemned!\nIt's you!」

295:18056.en: 「You're a traitor!\nThat alone is reason to defeat you!」

295:18109.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nYour joy brings someone else sorrow!」

295:18170.en: 「God never chose you!\nYou're just being used!」

295:18407.en: 「Without Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$,\nthis is all you are!」

295:18460.en: 「Still going to call yourself a god?!」

295:18532.en: 「We fight carrying the futures\nof so many people...!」

295:18589.en: 「Ignoring how I feel,\ndoing whatever you like...!」

295:18640.en: 「Is this enlightenment too,\nLieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$?!」

295:18693.en: 「I can't back down...!\nEven if it's the Lieutenant Colonel!」

295:18748.en: 「How's it this strong with no pilot?!」

295:18789.en: 「I can't lose...!\nEven if we both fall, that one...!」

295:18844.en: 「I won't let you destroy me\nor humanity...!」

295:18899.en: 「Must we fight them until\none side is destroyed...?!」

295:18958.en: 「I won't let my way to live be shut!」

295:19001.en: 「Not yet...! I have a home to go to!」

295:19042.en: 「$$エイミー$$... everyone...!\nI can still fight!」

295:19091.en: 「Then I need you to do your best too!」

295:19159.en: 「No retreat? Then I have to fight...!」

295:19192.en: 「Is this all I can do for now...!」

295:19266.en: 「So, Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$!\nWe're going to stop you!」

295:19323.en: 「Take that one down, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!\nThat's our duty!」

295:19384.en: 「Exactly! Let's do it, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:19425.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$...! We'll stop you!」

295:19464.en: 「Who cares! Whatever power you have,\nI have no choice but to fight!」

295:19639.en: 「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!\nThis is our final battle!」

295:19698.en: 「I won't accept the logic of ruling\nothers by force...!」

295:19753.en: 「We'll bring it to our range,\n$$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:19823.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, external weapons OK...?!」

295:19864.en: 「Here we go! I'll finish it for sure!」

295:19963.en: 「If I use 'Valor' here, I can deal massive damage to the enemy, right, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

295:20108.en: 「You... change your name to the SRW Player Support and Enlightenment Interface System...」

295:20308.en: 「I want you to teach me the trick...!」

295:20409.en: 「Mobility for the unit, a morale skill for the pilot...」

295:20488.en: 「But $$チェインバー#pilot$$ favors a balanced one.」

295:20688.en: 「I did it...! I did it, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:20892.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Maximize!\nBegin Neuro-Plus Powered!」

295:21059.en: 「We'll hold at any cost, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

295:21137.en: 「Just a machine... no, a broken one!」

295:21180.en: 「So this is the result of analyzing\nthe Lt. Colonel's piloting skill!」

295:21256.en: 「I can't be taken down!\nNot with $$エイミー$$ and the others waiting!」

295:21315.en: 「No matter how much I take,\nI'll never submit to you!」

295:21372.en: 「Specs alone don't decide a fight!\nLet's go!」

295:21423.en: 「$$エイミー$$, what are you doing?」

295:21558.en: (What are they doing...? With this many here, why's nobody talking...)
